name: linux-port-foundation
title: Establish Linux runtime foundation and port base hooks
description: Integrate the proven Linux port knowledge from name8102/eu4dll_linux into the refactored multi-platform architecture, stopping at a production-quality Linux runtime foundation plus the EU4 1.37.5 linux_x86_64 base vertical slice.
scope: Linux build graph, ELF process memory, executable identity, patch runtime branch reachability and atomic batches, Linux target profile, bootstrap/loading, base hooks, tests, and migration documentation
creator: charl
notes: Use eu4dll_mac/main as the canonical tree. Treat name8102/eu4dll_linux@linux-port as a Linux binary-research and working-prototype source, not as a source tree to merge. Do not port textLayout, mainText, mapText, text3D, input, pinyin, or save-file features in this task.
